hypothesis: The competition's DTI metric admits a closed-form marginal rule — add a pixel iff its expected kernel credit exceeds alpha times the current DTI — and emitting by exact joint greedy under that rule beats emitting by probability threshold or by fixed spacing at matched mass, because the 300 m kernel makes adjacent picks redundant.
mechanism: T = TP_w, S = sum(p), M = sum(p*kmax), K = |G| gives DTI = T/(alpha*(T+S-M)+beta*K+eps) with alpha=0.2, beta=0.8. Adding unit mass at x changes T by dT(x) = sum_{g: d<=R} max(0, k(d) - best(g)) and M by kmax(x), so the denominator moves by alpha*(dT + 1 - kmax). In the non-redundant case dT = kmax = kappa this reduces to gain > 0 iff kappa > alpha*DTI. Emission is lazy-greedy (CELF-exact, since dT is non-increasing in added mass) over an ensemble of 32 plausible truth rasters, followed by backward pruning, with a live-calibrated discount rho=0.1575 applied to the kernel weight of any cell within 2 px of the published catalogue.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Regional geomorphic and geophysical fabric that is not a fault: (a) basalt flow fronts and caldera ring fractures, which produce linear topographic and magnetic-gradient anomalies indistinguishable from a scarp at 100 m; (b) alluvial-fan toes and range-front facies changes, which produce conductivity gradients and sharp depth-to-basement steps for purely sedimentary reasons; (c) joint sets and lithologic contacts in the bedrock, which the geodetic second invariant and the tilt band both respond to without any Quaternary displacement. Any of these would raise the physical field's blocked AUC while contributing zero DTI credit, and the leakage canary cannot distinguish them from real faults because they are not leakage — they are confounders.

holdout_dti.why: The hide-and-recover holdout available locally has the published catalogue as its only truth. This lane deliberately avoids the catalogue flank (measured 6.3x credit depletion), so its emission has TP_w = 0 against catalogue truth by construction. Reporting a DTI of 0.0000 as if it were a holdout score would be actively misleading. The gate that is meaningful is the rule comparison, below.

C7_joint_greedy_beats_independent_thresh.note: both rules see only the 32-draw ensemble and are scored on a held-out draw. NOT mass-matched: rule B stops where the exact marginal gain is <= 0, which is the DTI-optimal stopping point; rule A emits everything above the naive bar and so spends 18-31x the mass for the SAME captured TP_w. That identity of TP_w is the whole finding: the extra mass buys no credit and pays alpha=0.2 per unit.
